text_block_list.text:
One day, after Curren Chan has a
number of
victories under her belt...

Luggage in hand, Curren Chan and I
arrive at the
hot spring for the vacation
we won in the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We've made it to the inn!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What a relaxing vibe! This is gonna be
the perfect
vacation. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go check out the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll let you handle it! I believe in youuu! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll let you handle it! I believe in youuu! ♪

Curren Chan seems even more cheerful
than
usual. I guess she's been really
looking forward to
this vacation.
So, without wasting any time...
Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whew! My skin's so much smoother
now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Am I even cuter now? Am I shining?
Sparkling?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're just agreeing with me, aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Juuust kidding! I know you're always
thinking of
me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Juuust kidding! I know you're always
thinking of
me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I was actually thinking...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you'd be able to relax more if I
wasn't
here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you'd be able to relax more if I
wasn't
here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know I can be a bit
self-centered. I do
things without asking,
I drag you along and make
you do what I
want...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know I can be a bit
self-centered. I do
things without asking,
I drag you along and make
you do what I
want...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you never try to stop me... I had a
feeling you
would from the beginning,
and that's why I chose
you to be my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you never try to stop me... I had a
feeling you
would from the beginning,
and that's why I chose
you to be my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, I know. You really don't mind, do
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even if what I wanna do isn't perfect,
you
understand me... and you genuinely
want to see
me realizing my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You want to be there with me. I never
imagined
I'd find someone like you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And that's all the more reason I wanted
you to be
able to take a break without
me being there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... even knowing all that, I just can't
bring
myself to keep my mouth shut and
do that for
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
After all, I know that's not how you want
me to
be.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
After all, I know that's not how you want
me to
be.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So... thanks. Thank you for always
spoiling me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I was invincible back when I was on my own. But... you've given me a reason to stay invincible, as well as a reason to pursue cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And it's because I have that reason that
my path
can shine brighter than before.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So I just want you to know that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think you're cute too, Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think you're cute too, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just keep thinking of me a whooole
bunch more,
'kay? And...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Love me a whooole bunch more too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis!

I sense that Curren Chan and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
